name: Jellyfin
description: Stream your movies, shows and music to any device.
compose:
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:latest
    container_name: jellyfin
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:8096"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/config
      - {DATA}/cache:/cache
      - /srv/media:/media:ro
notes: Your media goes in /srv/media (change the folder in /opt/jellyfin/docker-compose.yml). For hardware video encoding add  devices: [/dev/dri:/dev/dri]  there.
